subject: Courier hand‑carry, signing token handoff, and activation runbook
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@valebank.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@couriersuite.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 08:15:00 +0100
Subject: Courier hand‑carry, signing token handoff, and activation runbook

Hi Ravi / Daniel —

Following our phone sync this morning, attaching the first draft of the physical delivery and activation checklist for ValaBank's sealed deployment. High level ask: confirm courier ETA, operator contact at the ValaBank site, and whether ValaBank will accept Redwood's sealed signing token or provide a customer-managed HSM key at time of activation.

Critical acceptance items (please reply inline):
- Manifest matches delivered media: 5 x sealed SSD kits (operator image + delta), manifest attached. [Attachment: activation-manifest_v1.txt (text/plain)]
- Courier identity proof (driver ID + chain-of-custody form) to be provided at handover
- Signing token: Redwood can provide a sealed hardware token containing the private signing key; it must be handed to on-site operator and verified by fingerprint before activation
- Operator verification steps and rollback window documented (see signer checklist we will share)
- Activation window: target 2028-09-20 02:00–04:00 UTC (off‑hours) — confirm local site availability

Proposed next steps:
1) Daniel to confirm courier pickup and provide ticket ID / tracking; provide digital copy of courier label
2) ValaBank to nominate operator point of contact and sign the custody acknowledgment
3) Kimberly to send signer-instructions and verification checklist to on-site operator (we will request a signed readback)
4) Final runbook (inc. fingerprint values and rollforward steps) will be uploaded and signoff requested 48h before window

Please confirm the three acceptance items above and call out any GRC requirements we have missed.

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: activation-manifest_v1.txt]

From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@valebank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@couriersuite.com>
Cc: ValaBank Ops <ops+oncall@valebank.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Courier hand‑carry, signing token handoff, and activation runbook

Rafael — thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) We confirm site availability for 2028-09-20 02:00–04:00 UTC. Our on‑site operator will be Priya Nambiar (priya.nambiar@valebank.com) — she'll sign the custody form and perform verification steps.

2) For compliance we prefer to use our HSM for private key material when possible. Two options:
   - Redwood provides a sealed signing token and Priya performs a fingerprint compare and signs the activation statement (we will accept this if the token is sealed and the fingerprint matches the value you publish); or
   - Redwood signs the bundle remotely and we import the signed artifact into our HSM, with chain-of-custody verified on delivery (this requires additional attestation paperwork).

3) Courier: Daniel, please confirm the driver name/ID and provide a PDF of the courier label and the CS ticket you referenced.

We also need to ensure audit artifacts will include:
- SHA256 manifest of all images and individual files (we will verify hashes on receipt)
- Timestamped photo of seal before and after opening
- Signed custody acknowledgment (Priya) executed at handover

Appreciate if Kimberly can send the operator checklist and the fingerprint values for the sealed token.

Thanks,
Ravi
Ravi Shah
Head of Infrastructure Security, ValaBank
[Attachment: courier-label-CS-4891.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@valebank.com>, ValaBank Ops <ops+oncall@valebank.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@couriersuite.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 13:48:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Courier hand‑carry, signing token handoff, and activation runbook

Folks — forwarding a concise operator checklist and verifier steps. I've attached a PDF with the exact command snippets, expected fingerprints, and the custody acknowledgment template. Summary below (please treat as checklist items that Priya will read back):

Operator checklist (on receipt):
- Verify courier identity: driver name + government ID (take timestamped photo)
- Verify manifest SHA256 hashes (we provide full manifest and individual file checksums)
- Photograph outer seal and inner seal prior to opening; attach to custody form
- Verify hardware signing token fingerprint: SHA256: a3:5c:9b:...:ef (full value in signer-instructions_v2.pdf)
- Insert token into hotspot (USB-A) only after operator confirms fingerprint and signs custody form
- Activate op by running the provided activation script (./activate.sh) under operator account; keep serial console logs and collect first-boot hashes
- If any mismatch, do not proceed — call Redwood on emergency number +1-888-REDWOOD-OPS and escalate to Ben Carter immediately

Rollout safety:
- Canary slot: only enable one rack (slot-1) for initial activation; wait 30 minutes and validate 10 production queries against smoke prompts; if OK, proceed with rest of racks in 30‑minute windows
- Rollback: operator retains sealed spare media and a verified previous-image key should be present on the token for immediate re-swap

Attachments: signer-instructions_v2.pdf (includes fingerprint, activation script hash, custody form template)
Docusign: please complete the custody acknowledgment here: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

Rafael — if this looks good I will upload the final runbook and publish the fingerprint values to the secure link 48h before the window.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signer-instructions_v2.pdf]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@valebank.com>, Priya Nambiar <priya.nambiar@valebank.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@couriersuite.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 16:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Courier hand‑carry, signing token handoff, and activation runbook

All — thank you for the quick responses and confirmations.

Confirmations:
- Daniel: we have CS-4891 for the courier; please post driver name/ID and a copy of the chain‑of‑custody form to the ticket by 2028-09-18 EOD.
- Ravi / Priya: Redwood will proceed with Option A (sealed signing token handover) unless you explicitly request remote signing by 2028-09-16 EOD. We will upload the full fingerprint and final manifest to the secure runbook link on 2028-09-18 at 09:00 UTC.
- Kimberly: please publish the final signer-instructions and include the activation script hash in the runbook upload.

Final timeline:
- 2028-09-18 09:00 UTC — final runbook published (fingerprint + manifest)
- 2028-09-19 12:00 UTC — custody acknowledgment (DocuSign) required from Priya
- 2028-09-20 02:00–04:00 UTC — activation window (canary first, then staggered)

If there are no further compliance objections we will treat this as the activation plan and proceed with courier pickup tomorrow morning.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
